commitResults.messageTitle: Renamed chatbot from Duke to Cookie
commitResults.messageBody:
*Renamed chatbot to Cookie
*Updated all references of Duke to Cookie
*Updated ASCII-art banner to display COOKIE

*Modified Level 0 code to be structured as smaller methods greet() and
exit()
*Added support for echo to allow input until "bye" terminates it

commitResults.messageTitle: Add support for add, list features
Add support for mark/unmark task as done feature
commitResults.messageBody:
*Created a new class Task to contain both description and status instead
of the old String-only description
*Added markTask() and unmarkTask() to support the new feature
*Created a new skill to present code diffs visually
*Updated list() to include checkboxes and a display message.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add exception-based handling for invalid commands and task inputs
Add task deletion and expanded UI test coverage
commitResults.messageBody: Support deleting tasks and cover deletion, validation boundaries, task lifecycles, and whitespace handling in the console UI plan.

commitResults.messageTitle: Refactor switch statement to use Command enum
Refactor Task to abstract class and add TaskType enum
Add support for saving the task list to disk
commitResults.messageBody:
Save the task list automatically whenever it changes using UTF-8 encoding and
try-with-resources. Create the data directory when necessary and update the
UI test expectation for unknown commands.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add support for loading task list from disk
commitResults.messageBody:
Load todo, deadline, and event records at startup while restoring their
completion states and type-specific details. Isolate UI tests and add
coverage for loading persisted tasks.

commitResults.messageTitle: Strengthen task persistence and test coverage
commitResults.messageBody:
* Reject the file delimiter in task details.
* Add round-trip persistence testing across restarts.
* Cover blank saved files and malformed records.
* Extend the UI test harness for restart scenarios.
* Update the persistence coverage map.

commitResults.messageTitle: Support optional dates and times for deadlines and events
commitResults.messageBody:
Add date-only, time-only, and combined date-time parsing with persistence and display formatting.
Add the `on <date>` command for listing deadlines and events occurring on a specific date.

Move ownership of the mutable task collection and its basic list operations out of Cookie. This creates a focused domain class while preserving the existing command handling, persistence, and console behavior.

Move Cookie's greeting, status messages, error messages, task listings, and date-query output into a dedicated Ui class. This separates presentation responsibilities while preserving command handling, task mutation, and persistence behavior.

Move task-file path management, atomic saving, loading, and saved-record deserialization out of Cookie. Storage now owns persistence while Cookie coordinates I/O failures through Ui and retains the existing command behavior.

Move input normalization, command resolution, descriptions, argument-count validation, and task-index parsing out of Cookie. Parser now owns the generic structure of user commands while Cookie retains task-specific date parsing and mutations, preserving the existing console behavior.

Move supported date, time, and date-time formatters and parsing rules out of Cookie. Parser now interprets temporal command values while Cookie remains responsible for task construction and user-facing error translation, preserving existing behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Move deadline and event parsing into Parser
commitResults.messageBody: Move /by, /from, and /to marker parsing, temporal validation, file-safe input checks, and parsed command result objects out of Cookie. Cookie now focuses on constructing tasks from Parser results while preserving all existing console behavior.

Replace Cookie's static task, UI, storage, and parser state with instance fields initialized through a constructor. Add run as the application loop and keep main as a thin default-path launcher, improving dependency isolation without changing console behavior.

Add explicit mark, unmark, and delete operations to TaskList and update Cookie to use them. Keep persistence rollback and user-facing messages in Cookie while centralizing task-list state changes in its owning class.

commitResults.messageTitle: Refactor: organize classes into Java packages
commitResults.messageBody:
Group command, task, storage, and UI classes into dedicated packages
while keeping src/main/java as the source root.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add JUnit coverage for core Cookie behavior
commitResults.messageBody:
Add tests for parsing, tasks, persistence, date/time handling, and UI filtering.
Document the 50% JUnit coverage target in AGENTS.md.

commitResults.messageTitle: Configure Gradle to run JUnit tests

commitResults.messageBody: Package the application into build/libs/cookie.jar with cookie.Cookie as the entry point, and document how to build and run it.
Document all public APIs, task types, constructors, fields, parameters, return values, and exceptions while preserving application behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Align Java code with SE-Education conventions
commitResults.messageBody:
Inconsistent imports and abbreviated task-index names reduce readability.

Standardize import ordering and use descriptive task-index names while
preserving application behavior.

Agent instructions need a single project-wide source of truth for Java
and Git conventions.

Require the project-specific Java and Git skills for future code and commit
work so subsequent changes follow the repository standards.

Java changes need a reusable checklist for the SE-Education basic and
intermediate conventions.

Add a project-specific skill covering naming, layout, statements, imports,
comments, and required testing guidance.

Commit and branch work needs a reusable checklist for the SE-Education
Git conventions.

Add a project-specific skill covering imperative subjects, informative
bodies, and meaningful kebab-case branch names.
